_source: Real frames from the CC0 FreeREAC capture corpus (reac-captures, distilled set); Roland gear only, bytes verbatim. 'libreac' is libreac's own decode of the same bytes (reac_ctrl_parse, reac_upstream_decode at libreac 5b20ef1) so the grammar is checked against a second decoder; the arithmetic checks in real_xcheck.py read the bytes themselves.
